fields.description: Issue features editorials and commentary on Miami municipal governance and politics, including criticism of the city commission’s actions and contracting (notably a band contract with the Scotch Highlanders Band), discussion of the ongoing grand jury and police scandal investigations, and political implications for upcoming elections. Additional pieces address proposed sites for a new Miami post office, the growth and needs of the Dade County Fair, and an overview of the local ice industry’s economic importance, alongside local news briefs, society items, and extensive advertising.
